game-intro: Pit the nummers thegither an win tae the 2048 tile!
game-explanation: Use yer arra keys tae shift the tiles. Whan twa tiles wi the same nummer touch, they rin thegither intae yin!
copy-warning: <note>Note:</note> This steid is <emph>no</emph> the offeecial version o 2048, but it's only the translation strings that's different. Ye can play the offeecial version on yer phone at <official-site>http://git.io/2048.</official-site> Aw ither apps or steids is taen frae this yin (like this yin) or's fakes, an shoud be uised wi care.
translations: This variant has tryin-oot, fowk-made, no-feenisht-yet translations - see <weblate>this Weblate project</weblate> for mair on it.
